scope: History polling and mutation coordination amendment
outcome: Scheduler starvation and concurrent mutation history overwrite blocker resolved

supersedes_intentionally.reason: Original history effect restarted slow reads on every2s poll or10s context tick; a tick could also start history during a mutation. Previous receipt remains immutable.

behavior: One active read retains one original15s deadline. Repeated2s/10s/manual refreshes coalesce into at most one subsequent read.
History lifecycle dependencies exclude periodic context tick, run updates and busy presentation state.
Both C17 and run mutation paths pause/abort history before dispatch and resume only after their ownership-checked completion.
Navigation, invalid URL, access denial and unmount dispose immediately; signal, selection and epoch checks reject late publication.
